validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="order">
  <state id="order">
    <onentry>
      <send event="order.placed" target="#_parent"
            event:schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}},"required":["quantity"]}'>
        <content>{"quantity": 0}</content>
      </send>
    </onentry>
    <transition target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the literal data of `<send>` does not satisfy its own `event:schema`
notes: the `<content>` is literal JSON, so the event data it creates is known before the document runs, and the element's literal `event:schema` describes that data
diagnostics.help: change the `<content>` to data the schema admits, or correct the schema
